name: You Yashima
source:
Former employee of Aoyagi Productions.

After their friend [url=/c130408]Karen[/url] had let them go from the company on account of their poor performance, they're left searching for a purpose in life until they stumble upon [url=/c130411]Kuku[/url], who requests that they help her become an idol and revitalize her dwindling following.
